subject: suggestion-input
detail: B's suggest() takes one free-text string; A's Ticket has no text field (only status and a thread of agent replies), so it is undecided which ticket text the FAQ matcher reads
solutions: Match on the ticket's subject and description, set when it is created
Match on the latest message only
recommended: Match on subject and description: they are the customer's question; agent replies would make the agent's own words pull in FAQs
